description: This file defines models and logic for managing employee attendance, including sign-in/sign-out actions, attendance validation, and related classes in an Odoo module.

classes.name: hr_action_reason
classes.description: Model representing reasons for actions such as sign in or sign out.

classes.name: hr_attendance
classes.description: Model representing employee attendance records with sign-in and sign-out actions.

classes.name: hr_employee
classes.description: Extension of hr.employee with attendance status and sign-in/sign-out methods.

methods.name: _employee_get
methods.description: Retrieves the employee ID associated with the current user.

methods.name: _altern_si_so
methods.description: Checks that sign-in and sign-out actions follow correct sequence.

methods.name: _state
methods.description: Computes the attendance state ('present' or 'absent') for employees based on latest attendance record.

methods.name: sign_change
methods.description: Records a sign-in or sign-out action for an employee at a specified date.

methods.name: sign_out
methods.description: Records a sign-out action for an employee at a specified date.

methods.name: sign_in
methods.description: Records a sign-in action for an employee at a specified date.

methods.name: _action_check
methods.description: Validates that the new attendance action's date is not earlier than the last recorded action.
